note: quantile study, stage 1 (backtest pilot); plan frozen at tag quantiles-plan
headline: In a backtest the foundation model may have seen in training, a day-ahead position on GB demand set from Chronos-2's quantile forecasts, averaged with equal weight over quantile levels 0.10 to 0.90 (cost ratios from 1:9 to 9:1), cost clearly less than one set from its own median with a band built from its recent errors (score 370 against 373 MW, ratio 0.990, 90% interval 0.983 to 0.998; practically equal), and clearly more than one set from NESO's forecast with a band built the same way (ratio 1.320, 90% interval 1.263 to 1.374; practically higher). Chronos-2's 80% intervals contained outturn 71.7% of the time (too narrow; practically too narrow).
